name: team-clippath
blurb: Team member cards with clip-path image reveal on hover.
description: A team grid where each card's image is clipped and expands on hover, revealing full photo. Cards display name, role, and descriptive tags.
use_when: Team or contributor showcases where clip-path reveal creates a refined, modern interaction that highlights individuals.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where clip-path expand state might persist unexpectedly or block content.
a11y: Team info (name, role) is readable text. Images are semantic; clip-path is decorative visual enhancement. Tags are descriptive text.
